name: Code health report
ownerWords:
i don't want to do per PR checks, but daily Git reports and keep track of metrics.
things are meant to be first written in plan -> achieved ->  cleared & written on duty for maintanence only -> and valiantly persued whenever not met. JUST DO IT
goal: The daily code health report keeps working: every day the report page on the wiki shows that day's numbers for auto-sns-agent and sieun-pi, the DuckDB store holds a row set for both repos for each of the last 7 days, the store box holds a fresh dated copy, and the daily run has no failed step. The run is code-health.timer at 06:00 KST on us-metal02 (auto-sns-agent scripts/dev/code-health-daily.mjs).

metrics.label: Days of the last 7 with report rows for both repos
Hours since the report page got a new day
Hours since the newest store box copy
Failed steps in the last daily run

onMiss: Every missed metric gets a fix step under p5 with duty <dutyId>/<metricKey> and a live job that lands a code change for it, started with rlm.create_session; when the step already has a live job, steer it with scripts/job-steer.ts. Read the flagged items first: they name the missing days, the day the page shows, the newest backup and each failed step with its error. The run is code-health.timer on us-metal02 (systemctl --user status code-health.timer code-health.service, log ~/.local/state/virev/code-health.log), the code is auto-sns-agent scripts/dev/code-health-daily.mjs and apps/llm-wiki/scripts/code-health.py, and the page is served by llm-wiki.service from the checkout. report_days_7d: find why the run left that day or repo out and fix it; the next run backfills missed days of the last week by itself. report_age_h: find why the page step did not write today's table or why the wiki does not serve it. backup_age_h: fix the backup step (ssh and scp to root@100.84.91.26, backups/code-health). source_errors: fix each failed step's cause; a failed load-tests step is not counted until 2026-11-01, when GitHub's artifact quota resets. After the fix lands, rerun the day with systemctl --user start code-health.service on us-metal02, then rerun the precheck and report each metric before and after. A metric at 999999 means the precheck could not read its input: fix that first, in scripts/duties/code-health-report.ts in sieun-pi components/user-history. Nothing goes to an outside party.
